# begin crush map
tunable choose_local_tries 0
tunable choose_local_fallback_tries 0
tunable choose_total_tries 50
tunable chooseleaf_descend_once 1
tunable chooseleaf_vary_r 1
tunable chooseleaf_stable 1
tunable straw_calc_version 1
tunable allowed_bucket_algs 54

# devices
device 0 osd.0 class ssd
device 1 osd.1 class hdd
device 2 osd.2 class ssd
device 3 osd.3 class hdd
device 4 osd.4 class ssd
device 5 osd.5 class hdd
device 6 osd.6 class ssd
device 7 osd.7 class hdd
device 8 osd.8 class ssd
device 9 osd.9 class hdd
device 10 osd.10 class ssd
device 11 osd.11 class hdd

# types
type 0 osd
type 1 host
type 2 root

# buckets
host host0 {
	id -1		# do not change unnecessarily
	# weight 3.00000
	alg straw2
	hash 0	# rjenkins1
	item osd.0 weight 1.00000
	item osd.1 weight 1.00000
	item osd.2 weight 1.00000
}

	item osd.3 weight 1.00000
	item osd.4 weight 1.00000
	item osd.5 weight 1.00000
}

	id -5		# do not change unnecessarily
	# weight 12.00000
	alg straw2

	item host2 weight 3.00000
	item host3 weight 3.00000
}

# rules
rule replicated_rule {
	id 0
	type replicated
	step take root
	step chooseleaf firstn 0 type host
	step emit
}


rule r_indep {
	id 1
	type erasure
	step set_chooseleaf_tries 5
	step set_choose_tries 100
	step take root
	step chooseleaf indep 0 type host
	step emit
}
rule r_choose_osd {
	id 2
	type replicated
	step take root
	step choose firstn 0 type osd
	step emit
}
rule r_two_indep {
	id 3
	type erasure
	step take root
	step choose indep 2 type host
	step choose indep 2 type osd
	step emit
}
rule r_two_firstn {
	id 4
	type replicated
	step take root
	step choose firstn 2 type host
	step choose firstn 2 type osd
	step emit
}
rule r_leaf_neg {
	id 5
	type replicated
	step take root
	step chooseleaf firstn -1 type host
	step emit
}
rule r_tunables {
	id 6
	type replicated
	step set_choose_local_tries 2
	step set_choose_local_fallback_tries 5
	step set_chooseleaf_vary_r 0
	step set_chooseleaf_stable 0
	step set_choose_tries 30
	step take root
	step chooseleaf firstn 0 type host
	step emit
}
rule r_indep_osd {
	id 7
	type erasure
	step take root
	step choose indep 0 type osd
	step emit
}

rule r_ssd {
	id 8
	type replicated
	step take root class ssd
	step chooseleaf firstn 0 type host
	step emit
}
rule r_hdd_indep {
	id 9
	type erasure
	step take root class hdd
	step choose indep 0 type osd
	step emit
}
# end crush map
